records.text: :tada: New signup: *Cedar Dynamics* just joined on the team plan!

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 0 and a getting-started call was held as scheduled [calendar:1c29ce00], showing real engagement on a Team plan. But no invites sent and no reply to either outreach [email:d2b1504e, email:a2ca19ec], and key milestone still unreached 6 days in, so unaided activation within 8 days is possible but not likely.

draft.subject: Following up on our getting started call
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Thanks for making time for the getting started call last week. You've got your first project set up, which is the main thing -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the next step is usually getting your team in alongside you. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if that's easier for Cedar Dynamics.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that next step with you.

Best,
Priya
